title: DWG ModelDocViewStyle dictionary-derived name join
summary: After a successful DWG read, the dwg2dxf adapter resolves DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle names from their validated NOD child-dictionary entries, without relying on OBJECTS callback order.

behavior.route: DWG-origin adapter data only; DXF-origin style-name resolution remains in the existing DXF parser path.
requiredGraph: One unambiguous callback for the header-resolved NOD
One exact ACAD_DETAILVIEWSTYLE / ACAD_SECTIONVIEWSTYLE key for each populated family
A unique complete child DICTIONARY in the current import range, owned by the NOD
Each typed style has a unique valid handle, is owned by the child dictionary, and maps to exactly one nonempty dictionary key
No style handle, child dictionary handle, or case-insensitive style name ambiguity
behavior.transactionality: All graph validation and name allocation completes before assigning any style name. Refusal leaves existing typed names unchanged.
behavior.resourceAccounting: Dictionary-derived name payload bytes are admitted against the existing aggregate typed ModelDocViewStyle retention budget; repeat resolution does not charge the same names twice.
failClosed: Missing or ambiguous NOD callback/root key
Missing, duplicate, incomplete, aliased, or wrong-owner child dictionary
Invalid/duplicate style identity, wrong style owner, missing/duplicate target entry, empty name, or case-insensitive duplicate name
behavior.consumerCompatibility: No DRW_Interface pure virtual or callback-order change; this is post-read adapter-data completion for dwg2dxf.

tests.provenanceLimit: The test starts from a generated DXF callback graph, clears style names, and constructs a DWG-origin adapter envelope for the association helper. It does not exercise a real DWG parser or producer.
coverage: Detail and Section names derive from the expected child-dictionary keys with dictionary records retained in reverse order
Repeated resolution is idempotent and does not double-charge retained name bytes
Duplicate style target entry refuses transactionally
Exhausted aggregate name-retention budget refuses transactionally

scope.commitBlocker: Workspace Git metadata is read-only; changes remain unstaged and uncommitted.
